images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, one decisive action: an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. The cat is the dark caped nocturnal vigilante detective hero in a Neon megacity rooftop world, inside a cramped apartment kitchen at dawn during a Colossal statue awakening, performing a mid-air twist with a triumphant heroic expression around a floating brass time compass. The culprit is hidden in the cat's pink-nose reflection; reversed-time arcs expose the culprit while the rescued crowd erupts in celebration below the poster-like central silhouette. Rain-soaked, dark, weighty cinematic tone, no exact emblem. Safe compositing, hidden harness, controlled kitchen props, realistic paws and shadows. No logos, no readable text, no watermark, no famous artwork, no franchise design, no exact costume copy, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no plastic fur, no duplicate cats or limbs, no human features.
Required assigned visual details: rainy rooftop; no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
